The v7 adapter therefore translates only the Responses output-limit key while preserving the strict OpenAI provider pin.

transport_contract_conflict.repair: translate max_tokens semantic limit to max_output_tokens only on the Sol Responses wire payload

nullable_error_contract.semantics: error:null is absence of an API error; only non-null error values are fail-closed

probe_policy.purpose: tiny Responses transport/accounting gate before any full Sol benchmark request
probe_policy.error_handling: missing error key or error:null is non-error; any non-null object/scalar/list error stops before the full benchmark and is sanitized
probe_policy.missing_usage_behavior: stop before the full benchmark call and mark spend UNKNOWN/unreconciled unless exact usage is present

accounting_policy.successful_live_envelope: record exact recursively discovered usage and estimated cost before visible-final-text parsing
accounting_policy.error_envelope: non-null errors never proceed to full benchmark; account exact usage if exposed, otherwise keep spend UNKNOWN/unreconciled
accounting_policy.nullable_error_sentinel: error:null does not override otherwise exact usage and does not itself block the benchmark
accounting_policy.arbitrary_error_text: never retain raw provider error strings; retain only SHA-256, length and allowlisted diagnostic markers
